hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read file_path; if echo "$file_path" | grep -q '\.py$'; then uv run black "$file_path" 2>/dev/null && uv run ruff check --fix "$file_path" 2>/dev/null; fi; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read file_path; if echo "$file_path" | grep -q '\.md$'; then npx prettier --write "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; }

PreToolUse.description: Log all bash commands for debugging
